入职第一天在朝会上做自我介绍: Introducing yourself at the morning meeting on your first day
自我介绍要简短，控制在一分钟左右：所属部门、姓名、简单经历、决心。结尾必说「よろ: Keep your self-introduction short, about one minute: your department, your name, a brief background, and your resolve. Always end with 「よろしくお願いいたします」 and a bow. You can add 「さん」 to the names of senior colleagues within the company, but when giving your own name, use 「〜と申します」.
大家早上好。今天起销售部有一位新同事加入。小王，请。: Good morning, everyone. Starting today, a new member is joining the Sales Department. Wang, go ahead.
大家早上好。我叫王，从今天起被分配到销售部。: Good morning. My name is Wang, and I've been assigned to the Sales Department as of today.
我来自中国上海，大学专业是经营学。: I'm from Shanghai, China, and I majored in business administration at university.
这是我第一次在日本公司工作，想必会有很多不足之处，我会全力以赴，争取早日成为团队: This is my first time working at a Japanese company, so I expect I'll fall short in many ways, but I'll do my very best to become a contributing member of the team as soon as I can.
还请各位多多指导、多多鞭策。: I humbly ask for your guidance and encouragement.
谢谢。小王的带教由佐藤负责。: Thank you. I've asked Sato to be Wang's trainer.
我是佐藤。有不懂的地方，尽管问我。: I'm Sato. If you don't understand something, don't hesitate to ask me anything, okay?
谢谢您。佐藤前辈，请多关照。: Thank you. I look forward to working with you, Sato.
下面是今天的通知事项。下午两点开全体会议，请大家到第一会议室集合。: Now, today's announcements. There's an all-hands meeting at 2 p.m., so everyone please gather in Conference Room 1.
自我介绍时说明自己从今天起被分配到哪个部门: Used in a self-introduction to say which department you've been assigned to as of today
「言う」的谦让语，正式场合报自己的姓名: Humble form of 「言う」; used to give your own name in formal situations
谦虚地表示自己经验不足，常用于新人致辞: A modest way of saying you still have a lot to learn; common in a newcomer's speech
新人致辞的固定结尾，请前辈和上司多加指导: Set closing for a newcomer's speech, asking senior colleagues and bosses for their guidance
前辈对新人说的话，意为「有问题尽管问」: Said by a senior colleague to a newcomer; means "feel free to ask me anything"
回应上司指示的正式说法，比「わかりました」更礼貌: A formal way to acknowledge a boss's instructions; more polite than 「わかりました」
接听电话：对方要找的人不在，记下留言: Answering the phone: taking a message when the person is out
打电话预约拜访客户: Calling a client to make an appointment for a visit
到客户公司前台，被带到会客室: Arriving at a client's reception desk and being shown to the meeting room
在会议上提出不同意见: Voicing a different opinion in a meeting
向上司报告进度并请教（报联商）: Reporting progress to your boss and asking for advice (「報連相」)
向上司请假或早退: Asking your boss for time off or to leave early
处理客户投诉并提出解决方案: Handling a customer complaint and proposing a solution
委婉拒绝客户的追加要求: Politely turning down a client's additional request
向客户介绍新产品: Introducing a new product to a client
日企面试（自我介绍、志望动机、提问）: An interview at a Japanese company (self-introduction, reasons for applying, questions)
接待客户吃饭（座次、倒酒的礼仪）: Entertaining a client over dinner (seating and pouring etiquette)
安排出差、在新干线上与上司交谈: Arranging a business trip and talking with your boss on the shinkansen
因电车延误打电话通知会迟到: Calling to say you'll be late because of a train delay
去（「伺う」用于去对方那里拜访）: to go (「伺う」 is used when going to visit the other person)
回应上司或客户的指示、委托: Responding to instructions or requests from a superior or client
「了解です」对上级或客户显得不够礼貌: 「了解です」 isn't polite enough for a superior or client
无法回答客户的问题时，语气更委婉: When you can't answer a customer's question; softer in tone
邮件和电话开头的固定寒暄: A set greeting at the start of emails and phone calls
一直承蒙关照: Thank you for your continued support
对客户邮件开头最常用的寒暄: The most common greeting at the start of emails to clients
辛苦了: Thank you for your hard work
公司内部打招呼、社内邮件开头: A greeting within the company and the opener for internal emails
在展会等场合了解到对方公司后，第一次给素不相识的负责人发邮件介绍自己和公司时使用: Used when you've learned about a company at a trade show or similar event and are emailing the person in charge, whom you've never met, for the first time to introduce yourself and your company.
绿物产株式会社 采购部 山本健一部长: Mr. Kenichi Yamamoto, General Manager, Purchasing Department, Midori Bussan Co., Ltd.
冒昧联系，敬请见谅。: Please excuse me for contacting you out of the blue.
我是樱科技株式会社销售部的王明。: My name is Ming Wang, and I work in the Sales Department at Sakura Tech Co., Ltd.
这次在“制造业博览会2026”上参观了贵公司的展位，因此冒昧与您联系。: I recently visited your company's booth at the Monozukuri EXPO 2026 trade show, and I am writing to get in touch with you.
敝公司从事面向制造业的库存管理系统的开发与销售。: Our company develops and sells inventory management systems for manufacturers.
我们认为或许能为贵公司物流业务的效率化提供帮助。: We believe we may be able to help make your company's logistics operations more efficient.
附件是公司简介和产品资料，如能一阅，将不胜荣幸。: I have attached our company profile and product materials, and would be grateful if you could take a look at them.
如果您感兴趣，希望能有机会当面向您介绍。: If this is of interest to you, I would be most grateful for an opportunity to give you a presentation.
今后还请多多关照。: We look forward to working with you in the future.
樱科技株式会社 销售部 王明: Ming Wang, Sales Department, Sakura Tech Co., Ltd.
第一次给不认识的人发邮件时的开头语，代替「いつもお世話になっております」: Opening line for a first email to someone you don't know, used instead of 「いつもお世話になっております」
「言う」的谦让语，自我介绍报姓名时使用: Humble form of 「言う」; used to give your name when introducing yourself
「差し上げる」是「あげる」的谦让语，意为“给您联系”: 「差し上げる」 is the humble form of 「あげる」; the phrase means "I am contacting you"
请对方阅读资料时的委婉说法: A polite, indirect way of asking someone to read materials
委婉地请求对方给予面谈或说明的机会: Politely asks the other person for an opportunity to meet or give a presentation
书面语中对对方公司的尊称，口语中多说「御社」: Honorific term for the other person's company in writing; in speech, 「御社」 is more common
对方看过资料后，希望登门拜访详细说明，向对方提出几个候选时间预约会面时使用。: Used after the other person has looked at your materials, when you'd like to visit them to explain in detail and propose several possible times for a meeting.
拜访客户、开完会谈的当天，向对方表示感谢并确认后续事项时发送。: Sent on the day you visit a client and hold a meeting, to thank them and confirm the next steps.
会谈后按照客户的委托，把报价单作为附件发送给对方时使用。: Used when sending a quotation as an attachment at a client's request after a meeting.
委婉催促回复邮件: Politely following up for a reply
发出报价单后一段时间没有收到回复，需要委婉地询问对方的研究进展时使用。: Used when you've sent a quotation but haven't heard back for a while, and need to gently ask how the other person's review is going.
因我方原因无法按约定日期交货时，第一时间向客户说明情况、道歉并告知新的交货日期。: Used when you can't deliver by the agreed date for reasons on your side: you immediately explain the situation to the client, apologize, and give the new delivery date.
收到其他公司的提案，经内部研究决定不采纳时，礼貌地拒绝并维持今后的关系。: Used when you've received a proposal from another company and decided internally not to adopt it, to decline politely while keeping the relationship going.
确认会议日程变更邮件: Confirming a change to a meeting schedule
客户通过电话提出更改会议时间后，用邮件把变更内容整理清楚，请对方再次确认。: Used after a client has asked by phone to change a meeting time, to lay out the change clearly in an email and ask them to confirm it.
因调动不再负责某客户时，向客户致谢并介绍接任的同事，确保业务顺利交接。: Used when you'll no longer be handling a client because of a transfer, to thank the client and introduce the colleague taking over, so the handover goes smoothly.
想请带薪假时，提前向上司发邮件申请，并说明工作安排和紧急联系方式。: Used when you want to take paid leave: you email your boss in advance to request it, explaining how your work will be covered and how to reach you in an emergency.
负责召集部门例会时，向部门全员通知会议的时间、地点、议题和准备事项。: Used when you're in charge of organizing a regular department meeting, to notify everyone in the department of the meeting's date and time, location, agenda, and what to prepare.
年底向一年来关照自己的客户表示感谢，同时通知年末年初的休息时间。: Sent at the end of the year to thank clients who have supported you during the year, and to let them know your year-end and New Year holiday schedule.
公司准备订购一批礼品包装盒，在对方网站上看到产品后，第一次写信向供应商说明需求、: Used when your company is planning to order gift boxes and, having seen the products on a supplier's website, you write to the supplier for the first time to explain your requirements and request a quotation.
收到新客户关于商品规格、最小订购量和交期的询问后，作为供应商逐条答复，并邀请对方: Used by a supplier who has received questions from a new customer about product specifications, minimum order quantity, and delivery time, to answer them point by point and invite the customer to request a formal quotation.
客户看了第一版报价后，希望增加数量并调整规格，供应商按新条件重新制作报价单发送，: Used when a client who has seen your first quotation wants to increase the quantity and adjust the specifications: the supplier prepares a new quotation under the new conditions, sends it, and explains how it differs from the previous version.
报价有效期延长的通知: Notice of an extension to a quotation's validity period
客户表示内部审批需要更多时间，报价有效期快到了，供应商答应特别延长有效期，同时委: Used when a client says their internal approval process needs more time and the quotation is about to expire: the supplier agrees to a special extension while politely making clear that it's a one-time exception and that prices may change.
比较多家报价后决定向某供应商下单，把订单（注文書）作为附件发送，并确认交期、交货: Used when, after comparing quotations from several companies, you've decided to order from a particular supplier: you send the purchase order (「注文書」) as an attachment and confirm key conditions such as the delivery date and delivery location.
供应商收到客户的订单后，向对方致谢、复述订单内容并告知会寄送订单确认书和预计发货: Used by a supplier who has received an order from a customer, to thank them, restate the order details, and let them know that an order acknowledgment will be sent and when shipment is expected.
下单后迟迟没有收到发货消息，生产计划又依赖这批零件，买方礼貌地向供应商确认交期是: Used by a buyer who placed an order but still hasn't heard anything about shipment, and whose production schedule depends on the parts, to politely check with the supplier whether delivery is on schedule and ask for the exact arrival date.
交货延迟的通知（事前通知）: Notice of a delivery delay (advance notice)
交货日之前得知物流受台风影响无法按时送达，供应商在延误发生前及时通知客户，说明原: Used when a supplier learns before the delivery date that a typhoon is affecting shipping and the goods can't arrive on time: the supplier notifies the client promptly, before the delay occurs, explaining the reason, the new expected date, and the options available.
交货延迟的道歉（附改进措施）: Apologizing for a late delivery (with corrective measures)
由于我方生产管理失误，产品已经错过约定交期，且给客户的销售造成影响；在电话致歉之: Used when, because of a production management error on your side, a product has already missed the agreed delivery date and affected the client's sales: after apologizing by phone, you send a formal apology by email explaining the cause, how it has been resolved, and the measures to prevent a recurrence.
按订单将商品交给物流公司发出后，通知客户已发货，并告知运单号、件数和预计到达时间: Used after handing ordered goods over to a shipping company, to notify the customer that they've been shipped and give the tracking number, number of packages, and expected arrival time.
买方收到供应商发来的货物，清点数量和状态后，告知对方已顺利收货并致谢；同时顺便告: Used by a buyer who has received goods from a supplier and checked the quantity and condition, to let the supplier know the goods arrived safely and thank them, while also mentioning that one box had slight damage to its outer packaging but the goods were fine.
月底结算后，供应商把当月交易的请款单以PDF附件发给客户，说明金额、付款期限和汇: Used after month-end closing, when a supplier sends the customer the invoice for the month's transactions as a PDF attachment and states the amount, payment due date, and bank account for the transfer.
付款到账确认与感谢: Confirming receipt of payment, with thanks
供应商财务确认客户的货款已经到账，向对方告知已确认入账并表示感谢时使用。: Used when a supplier's accounting department has confirmed that a customer's payment has arrived, to let the customer know and thank them.
付款期限已过几天仍未到账，供应商第一次礼貌地提醒客户；考虑到可能只是对方忘记或款: Used when the payment due date passed a few days ago and the money still hasn't arrived: the supplier sends the customer a first polite reminder, in very gentle language, since the customer may simply have forgotten or the payment may have been overlooked.
第一次提醒后仍未付款也没有回复，供应商再次发信，语气比第一次更明确：写清已联系的: Used when the customer still hasn't paid or replied after the first reminder: the supplier writes again in a firmer tone, laying out the contact made so far, specifying a new payment date, and explaining that if payment still isn't made, they may have to consider suspending supply.
原材料和物流成本持续上涨，供应商决定提高部分产品价格；提前两个月左右通知老客户，: Used when raw material and logistics costs keep rising and a supplier has decided to raise the prices of some products: about two months in advance, the supplier notifies existing customers, explaining the reason, the size of the increase, and the effective date, and asks for their understanding.
拒绝降价要求: Declining a request for a price reduction
老客户要求下调单价10%，供应商经过内部研究认为无法接受，在感谢对方长期合作的同: Used when a long-standing customer has asked for a 10% cut in the unit price and the supplier, after internal review, has concluded it can't accept: the supplier thanks the customer for the long relationship while politely declining, and offers alternatives such as a discount for larger orders.
客户在询价时希望先看实物，供应商把几种颜色的样品寄出，并告知寄送方式、是否需要退: Used when a customer asked to see the actual product while requesting a quote: the supplier sends samples in several colors and tells the customer how they were sent, whether they need to be returned, and when feedback would be appreciated.
在电话或会面中客户提到想看产品目录和导入案例，营业人员当天把资料以附件发送，并简: Used when a customer has mentioned on the phone or in a meeting that they'd like to see your product catalog and case studies: the salesperson sends the materials as attachments that same day, briefly explaining what each one contains.
双方已就交易条件达成一致，供应商把一式两份的合同书邮寄给客户，邮件中说明签字盖章: Used when both sides have agreed on the terms of business and the supplier mails the customer the contract in duplicate, explaining in an email how to sign and stamp it, how to send it back, and by when.
收到对方公司起草的合同书后，买方负责合同的总务部门认为付款条件和损害赔偿条款对我: Used when, after receiving a contract drafted by the other company, the buyer's general affairs department, which handles contracts, finds the payment terms and the damages clause too burdensome for their side, and wants to propose specific changes and request negotiation while respecting the other party.
与新客户开始交易之前，供应商把会谈中口头商定的付款、交货、运费等交易条件整理成书: Used before starting business with a new customer: the supplier puts the terms agreed verbally in a meeting, such as payment, delivery, and shipping costs, into writing and asks the customer to confirm there's no misunderstanding.
初次联系／向旅馆介绍本公司服务: First contact: introducing your services to a ryokan
翻译公司的销售看到一家温泉旅馆的网站后，第一次给素不相识的总经理写信，介绍自己公: Used when a salesperson from a translation company, having seen a hot spring ryokan's website, writes for the first time to the ryokan's general manager, whom they've never met, to introduce the company's multilingual services.
展会参展通知／邀请客户来展位: Trade show announcement: inviting clients to your booth
本公司要在行业展会上参展，展会开始前约一个月，邀请平时有往来的客户来展位参观。: Used when your company is exhibiting at an industry trade show: about a month before the show opens, you invite clients you regularly do business with to visit your booth.
展会后的跟进／感谢来展位并提议试饮: Trade show follow-up: thanking a visitor and proposing a tasting
在食品展会上和对方交换了名片并简单交谈，展会结束后第二天发邮件致谢，并寄样品、提: Used the day after a food trade show where you exchanged business cards and chatted briefly with someone, to thank them, offer to send samples, and propose the next step in discussions.
拜访后的感谢／参观工厂后致谢: Thank-you after a visit: thanking a client for a factory tour
到客户的工厂参观之后，第二天向接待的厂长致谢，并说明参观中了解到的情况会如何用于: Used the day after touring a client's factory, to thank the plant manager who hosted you and explain how what you learned on the tour will be used in future proposals.
会议邀请／邀请合作方参加项目启动会: Meeting invitation: inviting partner companies to a project kickoff meeting
新项目即将开始，总承包方的负责人邀请几家合作公司参加启动会议，并请对方在期限前回: Used when a new project is about to begin and the person in charge at the main contractor invites several partner companies to a kickoff meeting, asking them to reply by a deadline about whether they'll attend.
会议日程变更／因故请求改期: Rescheduling a meeting: asking to change the date
每月例会已经定好日期，但因自己公司的系统更新作业撞期，主办方主动请求改期，并提出: Used when the date for a monthly regular meeting has already been set but clashes with system update work at your own company, so as the organizer you ask to reschedule and offer several alternative times.
和客户开完会后的第二天，把会议纪要发给与会者，请对方确认内容有无出入，并列出双方: Used the day after a meeting with a client, to send the minutes to the attendees, ask them to check for any discrepancies, and list the action items for each side.
回复出席会议: Replying to accept a meeting invitation
收到合作方的会议邀请后，回复将会出席，告知出席者姓名并顺便确认会场。: Used after receiving a meeting invitation from a partner company, to reply that you'll attend, give the names of the attendees, and check details about the venue.
收到行业协会的研讨会通知，但当天有出差无法参加，礼貌地回复缺席，并询问能否事后获: Used when you've received notice of a meeting from an industry association but have a business trip that day and can't attend: you politely reply that you'll be absent and ask whether you can get the materials afterward or send someone else instead.
线上会议的链接通知: Sending the link for an online meeting
和客户约好线上会议后，前一天发送会议链接、密码和注意事项，并告知连不上时的联系方: Used the day before an online meeting you've arranged with a client, to send the meeting link, passcode, and notes, and give a way to contact you if they can't connect.
介绍人给双方的引荐邮件: Introduction email: introducing two people to each other
中间人同时给两位熟人发邮件，向双方互相介绍对方，并说明为什么觉得两人应该认识，之: Used when a go-between emails two acquaintances at once to introduce them to each other, explain why they should meet, and then leave them to contact each other directly.
中间人引荐之后，被介绍的一方主动给对方写第一封邮件，致谢、简单自我介绍，并提议见: Used after a go-between has made an introduction, when one of the people introduced takes the initiative to write the first email to the other, giving thanks, briefly introducing themselves, and proposing a meeting.
负责人变更通知（由上司说明交接）: Notice of a change in account manager (handover explained by the boss)
因公司内部组织调整，客户的负责人要换人。由上司（科长）出面通知客户，并说明交接进: Used when a client's account manager is changing because of an internal reorganization: the boss (the section chief) notifies the client and explains how the handover and ongoing work are progressing, to reassure them.
新负责人的问候: Greetings from a new account manager
接手客户后，新负责人第一次给客户发邮件，自我介绍并表示会继续前任的工作，同时约定: Used when a new account manager takes over a client and emails them for the first time, introducing themselves, saying they'll continue their predecessor's work, and arranging a time to visit.
到任问候（新任分店长）: Greetings on taking up a new post (new branch manager)
被任命为分店长后，向分店所在地区的主要客户发送到任问候，表达继承前任方针、加强地: Used after being appointed branch manager, to send greetings on taking up the post to major clients in the branch's region, expressing your determination to carry on your predecessor's policies and strengthen cooperation in the region.
离任问候（退职）: Farewell greeting on leaving the company
准备离职时，在最后上班日前向长期往来的客户致谢，告知接任者，不详细说明离职原因。: Used when you're about to leave your job: before your last day, you thank clients you've worked with for a long time and tell them who your successor is, without going into detail about why you're leaving.
公司总部要搬到新办公室，提前约一个月通知所有客户新地址、电话号码、开始营业日期以: Used when your company's head office is moving to a new office: about a month in advance, you notify all clients of the new address, the new phone number, the date business starts at the new office, and points to note during the move.
年末年初休业通知: Year-end and New Year holiday notice
面向所有客户的批量通知，告知年末年初的休息时间、年前最后接单和发货的日期，以及休: A notice sent in bulk to all customers, announcing the year-end and New Year holiday period, the last dates for accepting orders and shipping before the break, and when inquiries received during the holiday will be answered.
新年开始营业的第一天，向平时往来的客户发送新年问候，感谢去年的关照，并请对方今年: Sent on the first business day of the new year to clients you regularly deal with, to wish them a happy New Year, thank them for their support last year, and ask for their continued support this year.
夏季休假通知（负责人个人休假）: Summer vacation notice (account manager's personal leave)
负责人自己要请暑假，提前通知客户休假期间、代理负责人以及紧急联系方式，并提醒对方: Used when the person in charge is taking summer vacation: they notify the client in advance of the vacation period, the person covering for them, and how to reach someone in an emergency, and remind the client to get in touch beforehand if needed.
客户投诉的初次回复: Initial reply to a customer complaint
客户来信反映送到的一批餐具有破损。当天先回复道歉、确认情况、说明正在调查，并告知: Used when a customer writes to report that a batch of tableware delivered to them was damaged: on the same day, you reply to apologize, confirm the situation, explain that you're investigating, and give the replacement arrangements and the deadline for reporting the results of the investigation.
投诉处理结果的报告: Reporting the outcome of a complaint
在约定期限内向客户报告餐具破损的调查结果，说明原因、已经采取的对策和替换品的交付: Used to report the results of the investigation into the damaged tableware to the customer within the promised deadline, explaining the cause, the measures already taken, and the status of the replacement delivery, and apologizing again.
给上司的工作日报: Daily work report to your boss
一天工作结束时，按照部门规定把当天做了什么、明天打算做什么、有什么问题简单汇报给: Used at the end of the workday, in line with department rules, to give your direct supervisor a brief report on what you did today, what you plan to do tomorrow, and any issues.
负责的项目按计划推进，在每周例行汇报时向部长报告当前进度、下一步计划，并请部长确: Used in your regular weekly report to the department head on a project you're in charge of that's going according to plan, to report the current progress and next steps and ask them to review it.
负责的开发工作因为外部原因可能赶不上期限，在问题变大之前尽早向上司报告原因、影响: Used when development work you're in charge of may miss its deadline for external reasons: before the problem grows, you report the cause, impact, and countermeasures to your boss as early as possible and ask for instructions.
向上司请示、商量: Asking your boss for advice and instructions
同时接到两项工作、时间安排不过来，不知道该优先哪一项时，向上司说明情况并请求指示: Used when you've been given two tasks at once, can't fit both into your schedule, and aren't sure which to prioritize: you explain the situation to your boss, ask for instructions, and arrange a time to talk.
自己的工作临时增加，想请关系比较好的同部门同事帮忙整理一部分数据，邮件里说明内容: Used when your workload has suddenly increased and you want to ask a coworker in your department whom you get along well with to help organize part of the data: the email explains what's needed and by when, and expresses your thanks.
总务部向全体员工通知经费申请规则从下个月起变更，说明变更内容、开始时间和咨询窗口: Used when the General Affairs Department notifies all employees that the expense claim rules will change starting next month, explaining what's changing, when it starts, and whom to contact with questions.
会议室预约与议程通知: Meeting room booking and agenda notice
预订好会议室后，向科内成员通知月度例会的时间、地点、议程，并请大家提前准备资料时: Used after booking a meeting room, to inform the members of your section of the time, place, and agenda of the monthly regular meeting and ask them to prepare materials in advance.
部门会议结束后，负责记录的人把决定事项、待办事项和负责人整理成纪要，发给全体参加: Used after a department meeting, when the person taking notes compiles the decisions, action items, and the people responsible into minutes and sends them to all participants to check.
需要去外地分公司支援展会，向上司提交出差申请，写清目的、日程、费用估算并请求批准: Used when you need to go to a branch office in another city to help with a trade show: you submit a business trip request to your boss, stating the purpose, schedule, and estimated costs, and ask for approval.
出差回来后，向上司和相关人员汇报出差的成果、获得的信息和今后的对应，并对支持自己: Used after returning from a business trip to report the results, the information you gained, and next steps to your boss and others concerned, and to thank the coworkers who supported you.
打算请几天年假回老家，提前向上司报告休假日期、工作交接情况，请上司批准时使用。: Used when you plan to take a few days of annual leave to go back to your hometown: you tell your boss the dates and how your work will be covered well in advance, and ask for approval.
因病请假的联系: Letting your boss know you are off sick
早上发烧无法上班，向上司说明情况、请当天的病假，并交代当天要处理的工作时使用。: Used when you have a fever in the morning and can't go to work: you explain the situation to your boss, ask for sick leave for the day, and pass on what needs to be done about that day's work.
迟到的联系: Letting your boss know you will be late
上班途中电车因故障停运，可能要迟到，在上班时间前给上司发邮件说明原因、预计到达时: Used when your train has stopped due to a breakdown on your way to work and you may be late: before working hours start, you email your boss explaining the reason, your expected arrival time, and the impact on your work.
公司规定加班需要事先批准，为了赶在明天前完成资料，向上司说明加班的理由和预计时间: Used when your company requires prior approval for overtime and you need to finish materials before tomorrow: you explain to your boss why you need to work overtime and for how long, and ask for approval.
会计科在月末前提醒全体员工按时提交经费报销，同时对尚未提交的人进行温和的催促时使: Used when the Accounting Section reminds all employees before the end of the month to submit their expense claims on time, while gently nudging those who haven't submitted yet.
部门来了新同事，由科长向部门全体发邮件介绍新人的经历和负责工作，新人本人也简单问: Used when a new colleague joins the department: the section chief emails the whole department introducing the newcomer's background and responsibilities, and the newcomer adds a brief greeting.
欢迎会・送别会的邀请: Invitation to a welcome and farewell party
部门既有新人加入又有同事调动，干事给部门全体发邮件，邀请大家参加欢送迎会并确认是: Used when a new member has joined the department and a colleague is being transferred: the organizer emails the whole department inviting everyone to a combined welcome and farewell party and asking whether they will attend.
人事部向全体员工通知信息安全培训的日程、形式和报名方法，并说明参加的必要性时使用: Used when the Human Resources Department notifies all employees of the schedule, format, and registration method for information security training, and explains why attendance is necessary.
信息系统部预告周末将进行内部系统维护，说明停止时间、影响范围和事前需要做的准备时: Used when the Information Systems Department gives advance notice of weekend maintenance on an internal system, explaining when it will be down, what will be affected, and what needs to be done beforehand.
发现办公室的复印机出了故障，向总务部报告故障情况、已经做过的处理，并请求安排修理: Used when you find that the office copier has broken down: you report the problem and what you've already tried to the General Affairs Department and ask them to arrange a repair, while also alerting coworkers on the same floor.
给客户的提案资料完成初稿，在提交给客户之前请部长审阅，说明重点要看的地方和期限时: Used when you've finished the first draft of proposal materials for a client and want the department head to review them before they go to the client, explaining which points to focus on and the deadline.
感谢同事的帮助: Thanking a coworker for their help
同事帮忙整理数据，让自己的会议汇报顺利完成，会后向同事表示感谢，并告诉对方帮助起: Used after a coworker helped you organize data so that your report at a meeting went smoothly: you thank them afterward and tell them how their help made a difference.
在企业官网上看到社会招聘（中途採用）的招聘信息，向人事负责人发送应聘邮件，并附上: Used when you've seen a mid-career job opening (「中途採用」) on a company's website and are emailing the HR contact to apply, attaching your résumé and detailed work history.
企业人事发来面试通知并给出几个候选时间，求职者从中选定一个时间回复时使用。收到通: Used when a company's HR department has sent an interview notice with several possible times, and the applicant replies choosing one of them. Reply as soon as possible after receiving the notice.
面试结束的当天，向人事负责人表示感谢，并结合面试中印象深刻的内容，简短地重申自己: Sent on the day of an interview to thank the HR contact and briefly restate your interest in the job, mentioning something from the interview that left a strong impression.
接受录用通知（内定承诺）: Accepting a job offer (「内定承諾」)
收到企业的录用通知（内定）后，决定入职，回复人事负责人表示接受时使用。: Used when you've received a job offer (「内定」) from a company, decided to join, and are replying to the HR contact to accept it.
婉拒录用（辞退内定）: Declining a job offer (「内定辞退」)
已收到录用通知，但经过考虑决定去其他公司，向人事负责人表示辞退并致歉。原则上应先: Used when you've received a job offer but, after consideration, decided to go to another company: you tell the HR contact you are declining and apologize. As a rule, you should call first and use the email as a formal follow-up.
大学生在企业主页上看到暑期实习的招募信息，按照要求用邮件报名时使用。: Used when a university student has seen a summer internship posting on a company's website and applies by email as instructed.
请求拜访校友前辈（OB访问）: Asking an alumnus for a career visit (「OB訪問」)
求职学生通过学校的就业指导中心得到校友前辈的联系方式，第一次发邮件，请求对方抽时: Used when a job-hunting student has obtained an alumnus's contact details through the university career center and emails them for the first time, asking them to spare some time to talk about what the work is really like.
OB访问后的感谢: Thanking an alumnus after a career visit
拜访校友前辈、听对方讲完工作经验的当天，发邮件表示感谢，并具体说明自己的收获。: Used on the day you visited an alumnus and heard about their work experience, to thank them by email and explain specifically what you gained.
请求写推荐信: Asking for a letter of recommendation
已经换了工作的人准备报考面向在职人员的研究生院，需要一封前上司写的推荐信，于是给: Used when someone who has already changed jobs is applying to a graduate school for working adults and needs a letter of recommendation from a former boss, so they email the department head at their previous company with a formal request.
离职时向客户致意: Farewell message to a client when leaving the company
即将离职，在最后上班日之前，向长期合作的客户负责人发邮件致谢，并介绍接替自己的后: Used when you're about to leave the company: before your last day, you email your contact at a long-standing client to thank them and introduce your successor.
离职前约上司面谈: Asking your boss for a meeting before resigning
打算离职，在正式提交辞职申请之前，先给直属上司发公司内部邮件约时间单独面谈。邮件: Used when you plan to resign: before formally submitting your resignation, you send your direct supervisor an internal email to arrange a private meeting. Don't give specifics in the email; resignation should be discussed face to face.
因人事调动将调往其他城市的分公司，向一直负责的客户告知调动，表示感谢并介绍后任时: Used when you're being transferred to a branch in another city: you inform the client you've been handling of the transfer, thank them, and introduce your successor.
得知客户公司一直关照自己的负责人晋升为部长，发邮件表示祝贺时使用。: Used when you learn that your contact at a client company, who has always looked after you, has been promoted to department head, and you email your congratulations.
长期合作的客户公司迎来创立三十周年，由本公司社长名义向对方社长发送贺信。郑重场合: Used when a long-standing client company celebrates its 30th anniversary and a congratulatory letter is sent in your company president's name to their president. Because it's a formal occasion, letter conventions such as 「拝啓」 and 「敬具」 are used even in an email.
得知长期合作的客户负责人的父亲去世，向对方发邮件表示哀悼。商务吊唁邮件要简短郑重: Used when you learn that the father of your contact at a long-standing client has passed away, to send your condolences by email. A business condolence email should be brief and formal, with no seasonal greetings, no questions about the cause of death, and no request for a reply.
得知客户负责人因病住院一段时间、现已出院回到工作岗位，发邮件表示慰问和关心，并体: Used when you learn that your contact at a client was in the hospital for a while due to illness and has now been discharged and returned to work: you email to express your sympathy and concern, and considerately offer to accommodate them on work matters.
婉拒宴请邀请: Politely declining an invitation to a party
客户邀请参加年末的忘年会，但当天已有出差安排无法出席，礼貌地拒绝，同时表达感谢并: Used when a client has invited you to their year-end party (「忘年会」) but you already have a business trip scheduled that day: you politely decline while expressing your thanks and leaving the door open for next time.
客户邀请参加新产品发布会，回复表示乐意出席，并告知出席人数和姓名时使用。: Used when a client has invited you to a new product launch and you reply that you'll be glad to attend, letting them know how many people will come and their names.
给客户发送报价单时，误附了另一家客户的文件。发现后立即发邮件道歉，附上正确的文件: Used when you've mistakenly attached another client's file while sending a quote to a client: as soon as you notice, you email an apology, attach the correct file, and ask them to delete the wrong one.
发给客户的邮件中把对方的姓写错了（把“菅野”写成了“管野”）。对方没有指出，但自: Used when you wrote a client's surname incorrectly in an email (「菅野」 as 「管野」). The client didn't point it out, but you noticed and email an apology on your own initiative.
发错邮件后的更正: Correction after sending an email with an error
群发给多家合作公司的产品说明会通知中写错了日期和时间，发现后立即发送更正邮件，并: Used when a notice about a product briefing sent to several partner companies had the wrong date and time: as soon as you notice, you send a correction, marking the correct details so they stand out.
久未联系后的问候: Getting back in touch after a long time
以前合作过、但已很久没有联系的客户，借自己开始负责新服务的机会，发邮件问候并希望: Used to email a client you once worked with but haven't been in touch with for a long time, taking the opportunity of having become responsible for a new service to say hello and renew contact.
下个月起我调到销售部门。: Starting next month, I'll be transferred to the sales department.
总公司位于东京丸之内。: Our head office is located in Marunouchi, Tokyo.
我向大阪分公司的田中确认一下。: I'll check with Tanaka at the Osaka branch.
新的分店下个月在名古屋开业。: A new branch will open in Nagoya next month.
福冈营业所有五名员工。: Five employees work at the Fukuoka sales office.
我们公司的子公司负责物流业务。: One of our subsidiaries handles our logistics operations.
根据母公司的方针，明年起引进新系统。: In line with our parent company's policy, we will be introducing a new system from next year.
与客户的商谈从下午两点开始。: The meeting with the client starts at 2 p.m.
设立股份公司需要哪些手续？: What procedures are required to set up a joint-stock company?
这件事需要请营业本部来判断。: We need to ask the sales headquarters for a decision on this matter.
